## TA-T037 — least element / well-order / chain

Chosen rendering: **மீச்சிறு உறுப்பு / நன்கு வரிசைப்படுத்தல் / சங்கிலி**

Kind: `terminology`; confidence: `low`; provisional: `true`; priority: `high`.

Intended sense and rationale: Least means below all elements, distinct from merely minimal. Every nonempty subset must have a least element. Maximal chain means inclusion-maximal, not greatest cardinality.

Authority basis: TA-SC11-P3 (checked_supports); TA-SC11-P19 (checked_context_only); TA-T037-EXACT-TERM-NOT-FOUND (not_found)

Alternatives: None recorded.

## TA-T038 — successor / predecessor / initial segment

Chosen rendering: **அடுத்துறுப்பு / முந்துறுப்பு / தொடக்கத் துண்டு**

## TA-T039 — inverse / relative product / restriction / application of relation

Chosen rendering: **தலைகீழ்த் தொடர்பு / சார்புப் பெருக்கம் / கட்டுப்படுத்தல் / செயல்படுத்தல்**

Kind: `terminology`; confidence: `low`; provisional: `true`; priority: `high`.

Intended sense and rationale: Source formulas fix direction of composition and distinguish relation restriction from function-domain restriction. Application yields relational image, not a single value.

## TA-T042 — integer / whole number / natural number

Chosen rendering: **முழு, முழுக்கள் / முழு எண், முழு எண்கள் / இயல் எண்**

Kind: `terminology`; confidence: `high`; provisional: `false`; priority: `low`.

Intended sense and rationale: Recovered canon supplies a sharper integer/whole-number distinction. Replace earlier முழு எண் for integer throughout current drafts with முழு (plural முழுக்கள்). Preserve OpenLogic natural-number convention including zero, despite school-text convention starting at one; explain separately.

Authority basis: TA-SC6-P29-NUMBERS (checked_context_only); TA-SC6-P169-GLOSSARY (checked_supports)

Alternatives: None recorded.

Please double-check: **do the listed uses of “முழு, முழுக்கள் / முழு எண், முழு எண்கள் / இயல் எண்” preserve the OpenLogic sense of “integer / whole number / natural number” and read naturally in India-standard mathematical Tamil?**

## TA-T043 — numerical successor/predecessor versus tree cover

Chosen rendering: **தொடரி / முன்னி; மரவுருவில் அடுத்துறுப்பு / முந்துறுப்பு**

Kind: `terminology`; confidence: `high`; provisional: `false`; priority: `low`.

Intended sense and rationale: Recovered contextual evidence confirms தொடரி/முன்னி for n+1/n−1. Current relational chapters retain explicit அடுத்துறுப்பு/முந்துறுப்பு as generalized defined terms; record native alternatives without pretending school arithmetic attests arbitrary ordinal/tree covers.

Authority basis: TA-SC6-P2-SUCCESSOR (checked_context_only); TA-SC6-P169-GLOSSARY (checked_supports)

Alternatives: தொடரி / முன்னி are adopted for numerical use; parent/child vocabulary was considered for trees

## TA-T045 — function / mapping / argument / value

Chosen rendering: **சார்பு / இணைப்பு / உள்ளீட்டுறுப்பு / மதிப்பு**

Kind: `terminology`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `false`; priority: `normal`.

Intended sense and rationale: சார்பு and மதிப்பு contextually attested; mapping expressed with the native linking idiom. உள்ளீட்டுறுப்பு is a provisional explicit compound for the argument of a function, not a logical argument.

Authority basis: TA-SC11-P26-FUNCTION (checked_context_only); TA-SC11-P27-FUNCTION (checked_context_only); TA-SC11-P28-FUNCTION (checked_context_only)

Alternatives: செயலி / சார்பின் மாறி; logical வாதம் was rejected for function input

Please double-check: **do the listed uses of “சார்பு / இணைப்பு / உள்ளீட்டுறுப்பு / மதிப்பு” preserve the OpenLogic sense of “function / mapping / argument / value” and read naturally in India-standard mathematical Tamil?**

## TA-T089 — premise / conclusion / assumption / hypothesis / discharge

Chosen rendering: **முன்கோள் / முடிவு / எடுகோள் / கருதுகோள் / விடுவித்தல்**

Kind: `terminology`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`; priority: `high`.

Intended sense and rationale: The logic original attests எடுகூற்று, முடிபு and எடுகோள்; current SCERT attests கருதுகோள் and முடிவு for a conditional. The edition uses முன்கோள் for an argument premise, முடிவு for its conclusion, எடுகோள் for a temporary formal assumption, and defines discharge as ending that assumption's formal scope.

Authority basis: TA-IL1967-P112-113-INFERENCE (checked_supports); TA-IL1967-P264-265-PROOF (checked_supports); TA-SC12V2-P255-CONDITIONAL (checked_context_only); TA-T089-EXACT-TERM-NOT-FOUND (not_found)

Alternatives: None recorded.

Please double-check: **is “முன்கோள் / முடிவு / எடுகோள் / கருதுகோள் / விடுவித்தல்” the established India-standard Tamil expression for “premise / conclusion / assumption / hypothesis / discharge” in the exact senses at the listed segments; if not, what replacement preserves the distinctions in the rationale?**

## TA-T100 — variable / constant symbol / closed term / main operator

Chosen rendering: **மாறி / மாறிலிக் குறி / மூடிய சொல் / முதன்மைச் செயலி**

Kind: `terminology`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`; priority: `high`.

Intended sense and rationale: SCERT directly attests propositional variables and logical connectives. The broader first-order variable, constant-symbol, closed-term and main-operator senses are fixed by adjacent syntactic clauses; closed means no variables, and main operator is the connective or quantifier governing the displayed formula.

Authority basis: TA-SC12V2-P253-CONNECTIVES (checked_context_only); TA-TVA-D0412-QUANTIFIER (checked_supports); TA-SC11-P27-FUNCTION (checked_context_only); TA-T100-EXACT-TERM-NOT-FOUND (not_found)

Alternatives: None recorded.

Please double-check: **is “மாறி / மாறிலிக் குறி / மூடிய சொல் / முதன்மைச் செயலி” the established India-standard Tamil expression for “variable / constant symbol / closed term / main operator” in the exact senses at the listed segments; if not, what replacement preserves the distinctions in the rationale?**

Kind: `terminology`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`; priority: `high`.

Intended sense and rationale: The preserved logic original supplies the proof and inference register, while OpenLogic immediately defines theoremhood and derivability through LK sequents. Chosen rendering: **செல்லுபடியான தொடரணி / தொடரணியை நிறைவுறுத்தல் / தொகுத்தறிதல் கருதுகோள்**

Kind: `terminology`; confidence: `low`; provisional: `true`; priority: `high`.

Intended sense and rationale: No exact sequent-semantic Tamil headword was found. The definition states the complete two-sided condition: an interpretation satisfies a sequent when some antecedent sentence is false or some succedent sentence is true; validity quantifies this over every interpretation. The proof then uses induction on the inference count.
